[[File:Uldum.jpg|thumb|300px|Uldum]]
'''Uldum''' is a titan research facility located in the southern part of the [[Valley of the Watchers]], in the desert of [[Tanaris]].

The gates of Uldum are sealed shut, and the [[Stone Watcher of Norgannon]] claims that entry into the Uldum compound is only allowed for beings that have the [[Plates of Uldum]]. It also claims that Uldum is a research facility for the titans in their continuing efforts to enhance the biosphere of [[Azeroth]].<ref>{{Neutral}} [50] [[The Stone Watcher]]</ref> Returning with the Plates of Uldum results in the spawning of the world boss [[Ostarius]], the Gate Keeper, who seals the gates to the compound and engages players upon detecting the [[curse of the flesh]] on them.
